verdict.rationale: LocalAI is built to be self-hosted. The docs show a one-line Docker run that serves on localhost:8080 and describe the product as "one binary" and an "open runtime". It runs without a GPU via a CI-tested CPU path, auto-detects NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs, and supports self-hosted distributed worker nodes and multi-user auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and an explicit statement of the open-source license.
